**What was done**: Pre-ranked GSEA (genes ranked by log2FoldChange) against MSigDB Hallmark 2020 gene sets across all 24 Brefeldin-A conditions (4 cell types × 6 concentrations), with 1000 permutations per run.

**Key finding — BFA induces a purely suppressive transcriptional response across all cell types.** Zero Hallmark pathways were positively enriched (NES > 0, FDR < 0.05) in any condition. The pathways suppressed in ≥75% of conditions form a coherent secretory-disruption signature:
